repo_notes.content: Generate the wiki from the current main branch of tecxbro/daniel-ims-ag. Source code and convex/schema.ts are authoritative; README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md are orientation aids. Verify file paths, function names, environment variables, limits, schemas, tool registrations, and lifecycle behavior before stating them.

Document only behavior implemented in the repository today. Clearly label optional, configuration-dependent, and intentionally unsupported behavior. Do not include old branding, migration history, batch or phase history, private roadmap plans, or features inferred only from comments.

Write for a new contributor. Parent pages should orient and link; child pages should contain implementation detail. Prefer concise diagrams, tables, and sequence flows, and include repository-relative source paths, configuration, failure modes, security boundaries, and related-page links.

Never expose secrets, tokens, webhook signatures, real phone numbers, private user data, or local absolute paths. Use clearly fake placeholders. Distinguish the interaction dispatcher, normal execution workers, and coding workspaces, including their different tool and filesystem permissions.

Avoid duplicating explanations across pages. Note provider differences between Claude and Codex, distinguish API billing from subscription-backed runtime usage, and distinguish Photon Spectrum SDK streaming from webhook-based integrations.
